description: Cartographic colour redline parameters for the generate chain. Declares every numeric parameter and enforcement level used by compiler/color_checks.py; pending-business-review values are prototype calibrations, not accepted business thresholds. Distances are CIELAB CIE76 ΔE units; CVD simulation uses Machado et al. 2009 severity-1.0 matrices. This policy only tightens colour acceptance; it never admits capabilities or selects colours.

lightness_monotonic_tolerance.description: L* slack for monotonicity noise, in CIELAB L* units.

adjacent_delta_e_min.description: Minimum CIELAB CIE76 ΔE between adjacent classes.

cvd_delta_e_min.description: Minimum CIELAB CIE76 ΔE between adjacent classes after dichromacy simulation.
